about: A Markdown document rendered with the library's own components: headings, lists, tables, code, quotations, callouts and footnotes. No string of HTML is ever rendered.

links.about: `components.link` replaces the library's link: a link that leaves the site opens in a new tab with `rel="noopener noreferrer"`, and a link to a heading opens in the same tab.
links.source:
# Settlement

Payouts settle on the next business day. A payout above the [reserve threshold](#reserves) waits for review.

## Reserves

The reserve is 5% of the rolling 90-day volume. The [card network rules](https://example.com/rules) set the floor.

notes.source:
# Retry budget

Moved the retry budget from **3** to **5** attempts in `queue.ts`.

> [!NOTE]
> The backoff doubles each attempt, so the fifth waits 8 seconds.

- [x] Load test on staging
- [ ] Watch p99 for a day

policy.about: Headings at the page's level, a table named by its section, task items with lucide marks, a callout, a fence with a title and a copy control, a quotation and a footnote. `headingLevel={3}` starts the document below the scene's own heading.
policy.source:
# Data processing policy

Effective **1 October 2026**. Applies to every workspace on the *Team* and *Enterprise* plans.[^officer]

## Subprocessors

| Subprocessor | Purpose | Days kept |
| :--- | :--- | ---: |
| Aurora Mail | Transactional email | 30 |
| Northwind Storage | Document storage | 365 |

## Obligations

- [x] Record of processing activities reviewed
- [ ] Annual subprocessor audit signed off
- [ ] Retention job run for closed accounts

> [!WARNING]
> Erasure requests are answered within 30 days. Start the export first.

```sh title="export.sh"
curl -X POST https://api.example.com/v1/exports
```

> Personal data never leaves the EU. The full text is in [the processing agreement](https://example.com/dpa).

[^officer]: Set by the data protection officer on 12 September 2026.

review.about: A customer review pasted straight into the renderer. The script, the image with a handler and the `javascript:` link render as text: raw HTML is never parsed, and the parser drops an executable destination and keeps the link's words.

size.about: `sm` for a comment or a chat message, `md` for a page. The body text, the gaps and every component inside follow the size.

streaming.about: `streaming` closes a fence the stream has not closed yet, so the code shows as code while it arrives. Replay the answer to watch it stream in, 24 characters at a time.
streaming.source:
To rotate the key, run the script and restart the workers:

```sh
./rotate-key.sh --env production
pnpm workers restart
```

The old key keeps working for **24 hours**.
